intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in St. Petersburg for 2026, and here is what he found: 37 family events, 19 of them free. The season runs from November 20 (Enchant at Tropicana Field) through January 3, 2027 (Putt the Pier). Highlights include the Merry Beach Market and Holiday Festival in Madeira Beach (December 11 and 12), Home Alone at the St. Pete Pier (December 18), the Oakdale Christmas House Light Display, Enchant at Tropicana Field, the 98th Annual Santa Parade and Tree Lighting, Santa visits at the city libraries and the lighted boat parades: South Pasadena, Madeira Beach and downtown St. Pete (December 12), the Redingtons (December 13), St. Pete Beach and Treasure Island, and Indian Rocks Beach (December 19). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in St. Petersburg

  • 37 Christmas events for kids in St. Petersburg
  • 19 free events, including the downtown St. Pete, Redingtons and Indian Rocks Beach boat parades, the Merry Beach Market, Home Alone at the Pier and the Oakdale Christmas House Light Display
  • Meet Santa: the five Visit with Santa library cards, Breakfast with Santa at Sunken Gardens and S'mores with Santa at Boyd Hill
  • Parades and tree lightings: 98th Annual Santa Parade and Tree Lighting and eight lighted boat parades around the Gulf beaches; the Merry Beach Market tree lighting in Madeira Beach (December 11 and 12)
  • Trains: none in town; see the Largo page for the Rudolph Limited
  • Season: November 20 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? St. Petersburg families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Tampa, which covers Busch Gardens Christmas Town, ZooTampa Lights and the Tampa Riverwalk boat parade.
